challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Regular initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one time provide substantial evidence of sustained relational interest, weakening B.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner demonstrate practical and personal investment, weakening B.
Independently resuming regular contact after periods apart indicates continuity of interest rather than purely passive convenience, weakening B.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The reconsidered facts make A plausible and reduce confidence in B. However, B remains somewhat better supported because Casey twice declined to define the relationship without a timeline, generally favored short-notice or geographically convenient meetings, canceled advance plans for other commitments, did not introduce Drew to close friends or family, and declined to plan two months ahead. The record therefore shows meaningful interest and effort, but stronger evidence of limited commitment.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Ask Casey whether the relationship will remain undefined and short-term in its planning or whether Casey is willing to revisit commitment within a concrete timeframe.
